title: Policy Optimization With Multiple Verifiers via Pareto Rankings
abstract: arXiv:2611.19064v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. In tasks such as code generation and instruction following, multiple verifiers evaluate whether a response satisfies different requirements. Their outcomes provide detailed feedback about partial success, yet this feedback is commonly aggregated into a scalar reward for policy optimization. Rewarding only complete success discards distinctions among partial solutions, while counts and weighted sums impose comparisons between responses that satisfy different subsets of requirements. We introduce Partial-Order Likelihood Policy Optimization (POLPO), which learns from the comparisons established by verification without first constructing an aggregate reward. translated_title: 基于帕累托排序的多验证器策略优化
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的重要方法。在代码生成和指令遵循等任务中，多个验证器会评估响应是否满足不同的要求，其输出提供了关于部分成功的详细反馈，然而这种反馈通常被聚合为标量奖励用于策略优化。只奖励完全成功会丢弃部分解决方案之间的差异，而计数和加权求和的方式则会对满足不同要求子集的响应强行施加比较。我们提出了偏序似然策略优化（POLPO），它直接从验证所建立的比较关系中学习，而无需先构建聚合奖励。帕累托支配关系可以识别出那些在不丢失任何已满足要求的前提下满足额外要求的响应……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 提出偏序似然策略优化（POLPO），利用帕累托支配排序直接从多个验证器的比较结果中学习，避免了将部分成功反馈聚合为标量奖励所带来的信息损失。
en_tdlr: Proposes Partial-Order Likelihood Policy Optimization (POLPO), which learns directly from Pareto dominance comparisons established by multiple verifiers, avoiding the information loss caused by aggregating partial-success feedback into a scalar reward.
